1 Lead Advisor - Strategic AI Transformation Your Tasks
 * Assess clients' AI readiness, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * Design AI-native operating models - rethinking team structures, ownership, value streams, and ways of working to make organisations genuinely fit for AI.
 * Design and drive enterprise-wide AI adoption programs - from governance setup and enablement strategies to managing resistance and scaling AI initiatives across business units.
 * Lead change enablement programs that drive real adoption: transformation narratives, leadership coaching, and communication strategies tailored to CxO and board audiences.
 * Facilitate high-stakes strategic workshops, including Big Picture Event Storming, AI Readiness Assessments, and AI portfolio prioritisation sessions with senior stakeholders.
 * Shape AI governance frameworks in line with EU AI Act requirements - covering risk classification, ethics guidelines, and auditability.

Your Qualifications
 * 5+ years in strategic consulting or transformation roles, with direct exposure to C-level stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CPO, or board level) - from financial services, insurance, or beyond.
 * Comfortable in technical conversations - you understand modern software delivery, CI/CD, AI-assisted engineering, and architecture concepts.
 * Fluent in AI - you don't just understand LLMs, Agents, RAG, and data architecture concepts, you actively use AI tools in your own work: custom workflows, agents, or automation that go well beyond ChatGPT. You translate between business and technology with confidence, without needing to build production systems yourself.
 * You have arrived at a clear conviction: AI doesn't just change IT - it changes how entire organisations operate. You think in terms of parallel transformation across business, people, and technology, not sequential rollout.
 * Solid command of change management frameworks such as ADKAR, and organisational design methods including Team Topologies, Value Stream Mapping, or Operating Model Design - the broader your toolkit, the better.
 * Familiar with AI governance requirements, including the EU AI Act, risk assessment approaches, and ethics principles for AI deployment.
 * A track record of identifying and shaping new opportunities within client relationships, and the confidence to drive these forward independently.
 * written and spoken communication skills in German and English - both are required.

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.
 *  please refer to the application link for further information

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 75.000 and € 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

jobs.description:
Working with us means believing in the future; in the great people who are shaping it together every day and in the wide-ranging career paths it opens up. #believeinyourselfErste Group was founded in 1819 as the first Austrian savings bank and today it is one of the largest banking groups in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Department Description

The Team Corporate Underwriting & Analysis is part of the Corporate Risk Management Division of Erste Group Bank AG (Holding) and consists of a fair mix of underwriters and business analysts. It deals with corporate risk matters of Austrian and International Corporate Clients with strong focus on CEE.

The core competence consists in analyzing, recommending and/or taking credit decisions for corporate customers. In selected cases underwriters are supported by the business analysts with in-depth analysis, peer group comparisons and forecasting. 1 Corporate Risk Manager - Renewable Energy (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Assessment of the credit worthiness of large national and international corporates in Austria and CEE, including the forward looking assessment of the respective business model, repayment capability and liquidity (thereby dealing with loans, export-, trading-, project- and leveraged acquisition financings)

 * Deciding on loan applications either within your discretionary approval authority or preparing a clear recommendation to the final decision maker

 * Responsible for a dedicated portfolio of corporate client groups with focus on energy (renewable energy projects) as well as consumer goods

 * Defining of risk strategies on clients and the covered industry

 * Participating in client meetings

 * Cooperation with different departments and CEE subsidiaries within Erste Group

 * Contribution to various Group and Department projects alongside the credit process

Your Background

 * Graduate in business administration or law

 * Solid experience in Corporate Banking (Account Manager/Risk Manager/Credit Analysis/Corporate Finance) with min. 3 years of activity in these areas

 * Proven track record in risk management within the renewable energy industry

 * Familiar with lending products and legal basics

 * Strong analytical, writing and presentation skills in German and English to present complex issues concisely

 * Flexibility and resilience to perform in a fast-paced environment

 * Readiness to cooperate with colleagues of other departments/ CEE subsidiaries in a multi-cultural environment
